title: identity / identity.resolved (v1) data payload
description: Identity's reply to an identity.lookup_requested. Returns the canonical masterId for an email (minted if new, reused if known). No isNew flag by design.

requestId.description: Correlates with the originating identity.lookup_requested. Echoed verbatim from the request. Lowercase canonical UUID; the pattern is enforced (format is annotation-only).

email.description: The natural key that was looked up, in Identity's canonical (trimmed, lowercased) form — Q&A Round 31. A pragmatic shape pattern is enforced because 'format' is annotation-only.

masterId.description: The canonical masterId issued by Identity. Lowercase canonical UUID v4 (version nibble 4, variant nibble [89ab]); the pattern is enforced (format is annotation-only). Consumers idempotently upsert on this. Matches the lap.recorded precedent — AC1.
